public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline. The retrieved financial disclosure describes activity before the prediction, not a decisive breakdown or an orderly end to the financing model. No event found meets the early-resolution rule. Neither continued operations nor warnings about financing risk settle an eventual-collapse claim.
limitations: The breadth of the financing model and severity of damage require interpretation.
Public disclosures may omit private financing terms and exposures.
The monetary basis is unspecified, preventing a numerical financial verdict.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: NVIDIA's beat-and-raise financing machine will eventually fall apart and the damage will be horrendous.

statement.excerpt: So much money has left the system and been funnelled into so few hands as a result of Huang’s craven beat-and-raise machine, and when it eventually falls apart, the damage will be horrendous, and many people will have celebrated this event, unaware that it made things worse.

our_interpretation: The assessed forecast concerns the NVIDIA-linked financing model described in the context, rather than an ordinary missed earnings estimate.
The plain reading is a breakdown that causes severe financial harm across dependent businesses, investors or lenders.
The source supplies neither a deadline nor a numerical definition of severe damage. I do not add a loss threshold.
criteria.support_condition: Documented failure of the identified financing model, accompanied by severe losses or failures among dependent businesses, investors or lenders, with evidence connecting the damage to that breakdown.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A definitive, orderly termination of the identified financing model without the predicted severe damage. Continued operation or an isolated earnings beat cannot contradict an eventual forecast.

evidence.explanation: This records a completed debt repayment before the forecast. It neither demonstrates the predicted breakdown nor rules out a later one.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated records showing a breakdown and severe connected losses, or a definitive orderly termination without those consequences. Quantitative scoring would also require a clear loss measure and accounting basis.
